correctness.rationale: For unit x,y, a=sum min(|xi|,|yi|); the median satisfies ||m||<=a, ||m-(x+y)/2||=1-a, and both comparison points are in the triangle. Equality forces a=||m||=1/2, hence no opposite-sign coordinate overlap. Nonnegative directional derivatives to x and y then force equal values on their common-sign support and remaining disjoint half-norm tails. The converse is an exact disjoint-support norm identity. Explicit norm-one functionals prove both Birkhoff–James relations. Exact rational independent finite diagnostics passed 4510 assertions; the infinite assertion is proved analytically.
